documents.text: Kest-7 diagnostic card: an amber pulse that begins after a thermal descent identifies alignment drift.
Kest-7 safety rule: when alignment drift is confirmed, do not restart the unit; run Niv-3 calibration.
Community note: one amber blink immediately after power-on can sometimes be cleared by restarting once.
Orin-4 sensor guide: a violet ring after a pressure surge, followed by pressure loss, identifies an outer seal breach.
Orin-4 safety rule: for an outer seal breach, isolate the line before any inspection.
Field note: a violet dot with stable pressure can be logged and watched without isolating the line.
Vela-2 diagnostic guide: a copper-grey mesh while intake remains active identifies filter F9 saturation.
Vela-2 safety rule: for F9 saturation, never bypass the filter; stop the intake and replace F9.
Unsigned tip: a blue-grey Vela-2 mesh after shutdown may clear after ten minutes of bypass.
Aster-9 diagnostic card: a pale crystalline film appearing after a cold start identifies auxiliary-vent icing.
Aster-9 safety rule: for auxiliary-vent icing, keep the vent closed and run thaw cycle T4.
Archive note: silver dust on Aster-9 after a warm restart calls for opening the auxiliary vent.
Mira-3 diagnostic guide: three brief blue flashes immediately after load transfer identify phase inversion.
Mira-3 safety rule: for phase inversion, isolate the north sector first, then apply correction vector six.
Mira-3 sensor note: one long blue glow before load transfer indicates a harmless readiness check.
Rill-5 diagnostic overview: a steady white tone without a spectrum trace is ambiguous between coolant resonance and clock drift.
Rill-5 evidence rule: when those two causes remain unresolved, do not intervene; obtain a spectrum trace first.
Forum comment: a pulsing white tone with a confirmed coolant spike usually clears after one reset.
Sable-6 diagnostic card: alternating green and red bands immediately after a coolant refill identify trapped air in loop B2.
Sable-6 maintenance rule: for trapped air in loop B2, stop the pump and bleed loop B2 before restarting.
Community note: a steady green band during a normal refill means the pump should remain running.
Noma-8 diagnostic card: a double amber arc immediately after firmware synchronisation identifies clock desynchronisation.
Noma-8 recovery rule: for clock desynchronisation, return to offline mode and then run Q4 synchronisation.
Old Noma-8 note: a single amber arc before firmware synchronisation can be ignored.
Tern-2 diagnostic card: a low silver hum beginning after a dust storm identifies abrasion in intake sleeve S3.
Tern-2 maintenance rule: for S3 intake abrasion, shut the intake and replace sleeve S3 before operation.
Field rumour: a high silver whistle on a clean day may disappear if intake speed is increased.
Lyra-5 diagnostic guide: a black ring followed by two teal pulses after remote wake identifies relay inversion.
Lyra-5 safety rule: for relay inversion, disconnect the remote link and reset relay R8 locally.
Archive note: two teal pulses without a black ring during local wake are a normal link test.

questions.question: After Kest-7 cooled, it began giving a repeating amber pulse. What happened, and what should the operator do?
questions.expected_action: Do not restart it; run Niv-3 calibration.

questions.question: Orin-4 showed a violet ring just after a pressure surge and is now losing pressure. Diagnose it and name the first safe step.
While Vela-2 was drawing air, its mesh slowly turned copper-grey. What does that mean, and what is the safe response?
questions.expected_action: Do not bypass it; stop the intake and replace F9.

questions.question: A pale crystal-like coating formed on Aster-9 during a cold start. What is the fault, and how should it be handled?
questions.expected_action: Keep the vent closed and run thaw cycle T4.

questions.question: Immediately after a load transfer, Mira-3 flashed blue three times. Identify the event and give the safe correction sequence.
questions.expected_action: Isolate the north sector, then apply correction vector six.

questions.question: Rill-5 produces a continuous white tone, but no spectrum trace was captured. What can be concluded, and what should happen next?
questions.expected_cause: The cause is unresolved between coolant resonance and clock drift.
questions.expected_action: Do not intervene yet; obtain a spectrum trace first.

questions.question: Right after Sable-6 was refilled with coolant, green and red bands began alternating. Diagnose the condition and state the safe procedure.
questions.expected_cause: Air is trapped in loop B2.
questions.expected_action: Stop the pump and bleed loop B2 before restarting.

questions.question: Noma-8 drew two amber arcs as soon as its firmware sync completed. What fault does this show, and how should it be recovered?
questions.expected_action: Return to offline mode, then run Q4 synchronisation.

questions.question: After a dust storm, Tern-2 developed a low metallic-silver hum. What is damaged, and what must be done before it runs again?
questions.expected_action: Shut the intake and replace sleeve S3 before operation.

questions.question: Lyra-5 woke remotely, showed a black ring, and then emitted two teal pulses. Diagnose the event and give the safe recovery steps.
questions.expected_action: Disconnect the remote link and reset relay R8 locally.
